race.comment: Expecting a few of the first-starters to make their presence felt here. AVEDIS (7) has been very well-prepared for this with eight jumpouts, winning four, including the latest when he cruised to the line under a light ride. Should get every chance from the draw. COURT JESTER (8) is another debutant who seemed to have a little in hand in the latest jumpout. Didn't fare as well at the draw but looks to have the talent required to be a force. CRIES AND WHISPERS (1) has been the most consistent of the raced brigade and that race experience could prove crucial, especially from a favourable alley. KUNG FU PANDA (11) has the talent required to be competitive here and will be better for two runs back. SONG'N'DANCE (9) improved sharply in the latest jumpout when blinkers were applied and while he doesn't wear them here, it showed he's got ability.
